question: Lighting the paint as one surface did not lift Ask's painting: still 4 and 5 on looks painted against the 5 and 6 you chose. Close the brush epic, close it and carry the look as its own task, or keep trying here?
context: You chose on 1 November to try one more pass, lighting each paint layer as one surface, and to ship it only if Ask's painting on the try path reached 5 and 6. It was built for real and measured in seven versions and on the try path: every one scored 4 and 5, the same as before it, so it did not ship. Reads as a landscape stays at 8 and 8. The judges name the same stroke texture everywhere and crude shapes, not the lighting.

options.label: Close the brush epic as it stands
options.summary: The brush epic closes. Ask paints what you ask for (8 of 10 from both judges) with real, editable oil strokes, a point under a person's digital painting on looks painted. Nothing more is worked on for that score.
pros: Frees the loop after six passes on one number
Everything else in the epic is built and checked
cons: Ask's paintings still look plainly digital (4 and 5 against a person's 5 and 6)
options.mitigation: Anything you dislike in a painting you react to on the audit, and it becomes its own task.

options.label: Close it, and file painting that looks less digital as its own task
options.summary: The brush epic closes now. A separate, lower priority task picks up what the judges keep naming: every stroke in Ask's painting has the same texture at the same size, and its trees and shapes are crude. It would vary the strokes across a painting (dabs, long sweeps, thin scrubbed passages, thick highlights) rather than change how paint is lit.
pros: Frees the queue's top slot for the next feature
Keeps the goal alive, aimed at what the judges actually name
cons: Another pass may move the score as little as the last six did
options.mitigation: The new task carries the same 5 and 6 bar and stops after one pass that moves nothing.

options.label: Keep this task open and try the stroke variety here
options.summary: The epic stays open at the top of the queue, and the next pass tries varied strokes in it, closing when the try path painting reaches 5 and 6.
pros: The epic closes only when Ask's painting matches a person's
cons: Holds the top of the queue for a score six passes have not moved past noise
options.mitigation: A pass that moves nothing stops and says so, as this one did.
